name: After § 77
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 77a. Is deeply concerned about authoritarian practices in Peru, Ecuador and Argentina, including the repression of opposition figures, restrictions on independent media and the restriction of civic space; expresses deep concern at the erosion of democratic principles and the deliberate circumvention of constitutional guarantees in these countries; calls on the VP/HR and the Commission to use all necessary available instruments, without exclusion, to ensure compliance with the democratic and human rights clauses of the cooperation agreements with these countries, which involve their revision; condemns the adoption by the Congress of the Republic of Peru of the law on the Peruvian Agency for International Cooperation (APCI) restricting the activity of international non-governmental organisations and an amnesty law aimed at persons convicted, accused or under investigation for crimes and human rights violations committed during the internal armed conflict that affected Peru between 1980 and 2000, despite the opinion of the Inter-American Court of Human Rights, the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights and the international commitments of the Republic of Peru; is deeply concerned at the repression of social movements, arbitrary arrests, enforced disappearances carried out by the army, and attempts to undermine the rule of law in Ecuador; is concerned about the publication in the Official Journal of the Republic of Argentina of a decree extending the powers of the National Intelligence Secretariat (SIDE) and removing all democratic control over its activities;
